description: MCP interface for the Event-Driven topology. Provides tools for inspecting and validating event-driven configurations, resources for manifest and ruleset access, and prompts for event-governed implementation guidance.

tools.name: evolith-topology-inspect
tools.description: Inspect an Event-Driven topology configuration and return its parsed manifest, event channels, and corpus artifact references.

configPath.description: Path to the Event-Driven configuration file

includeChannels.description: Include event channel and subscription metadata

tools.name: evolith-topology-validate
tools.description: Validate an Event-Driven configuration against the topology ruleset and OPA policies, returning pass/fail per gate.

configPath.description: Path to the Event-Driven configuration to validate

strictMode.description: Fail on warnings, not just errors

resources.name: Event-Driven Topology Manifest
resources.description: Full topology manifest for Event-Driven, including metadata, artifact references, and corpus configuration.

resources.name: Event-Driven Rulesets
resources.description: All ruleset files for Event-Driven: native rules JSON, OPA Rego policies, and WASM bundle.

prompts.name: topology-aware-implementation
prompts.description: Guides AI-assisted implementation to respect Event-Driven topology constraints, message ordering, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
